ai_summary: This document from Atul Auto Limited outlines the new Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) requirements on the proposed Rs. 3.00 final dividend for FY 2025-26, mandated by the Income-tax Act, 2025, effective April 1, 2026. Shareholders must proactively submit specific documentation by September 11, 2026, to claim beneficial or nil TDS rates. A key red flag is that failure to provide timely and complete documentation, or having an unlinked PAN-Aadhaar, will result in higher tax deductions ranging from 20-30%.
